author: Unity
description:
Discover the Build Analysis window, a new tool introduced in Unity 6.6 designed to inspect and analyze the results of player and content builds.

In this video, learn what the Build Analysis window is, how to view build properties and steps, how to utilize build report files and logs, and how to inspect assets and dependencies included in your builds.

🔗 Build Analysis window reference: https://on.unity.com/BuildAnalysisWindow_Docs
🔗 Content directories reference: https://on.unity.com/ContentDirectories_Docs

[00:00] Introduction
[00:42] Inspecting a Player build
[01:31] Build reports and the Trace Event Profile
[02:30] The Assets tab
[02:45] Inspecting Content builds
[03:27] Future roadmap
[03:58] Outro
